```{=html}
<style>
body, html {
    font-family: 'Lora';
    color: #F2E6DF;
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    /* font-size: 1.6rem; */
}
.index-nav p a {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    color: #F2E6DF;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
}

.index-nav p a::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    background-color: #F2E6DF;
    transform-origin: bottom left;
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
}

.index-nav p a:hover::after {
    transform-origin: bottom left;
    transform: scaleX(1);
}
</style>

<div id="bg-container" style="
  height: 100vh;
  width: 100%;
  position: relative; /* Needed so the footer knows where 'bottom' is */
  
  /* Background basics */
  background-color: #333; 
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  transition: background-image 0.5s ease-in-out;
">

  <div style="
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 300px;        
    min-width: 300px;    
    
    /* The Grey Translucent Look */
    background-color: rgba(74, 74, 74, 0.4); 
    backdrop-filter: blur(1px);
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); 

    padding: 3rem;
    box-sizing: border-box; 
    
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center; /* Centers everything vertically in the sidebar */
  ">
    
      <div style="margin-bottom: 3rem;">
        <span style="
          font-size: 3rem;
          line-height: 0.9; 
          display: block; 
          font-weight: 500; 
          letter-spacing: -1px;
        ">
          Zhehao Hu
        </span>
        
        <span style="
          font-size: 1.2rem;    /* Change this number to resize Subtitle */
          display: block; 
          margin-top: 10px; 
          opacity: 0.9; 
          font-weight: 400; 
          font-style: italic;   /* Optional: adds elegance to Times New Roman */
        ">
          <!-- Read. Think. Write.  -->
        </span>
      </div>

      <div class="index-nav" style="
        font-size: 1.5rem;      /* Change this to resize Links */
        font-weight: 400;       /* Standard weight */
        line-height: 1.6;       /* Adds breathing room between links */
      "> 
        <p><a href="/about.qmd">About Me</a></p>
        <p><a href="/post/research/index.qmd">Research</a></p>
        <!-- <p><a href="/post/journal/index.qmd">Journal</a></p> -->
        <p><a href="/post/research/assets/CV-ZH.pdf">CV</a></p>
        <p><a href="/photography/gallery/gallery.qmd">Albums</a></p>
        <p><a href="/photography/gallery/motion-pictures.qmd">Motion Picture</a></p>
        <a href="https://zzzhehao.github.com" style="display:none"></a> 
      </div>

  </div> 

  <footer style="
    position: absolute;   /* Takes it out of the flow */
    bottom: 2rem;         /* Distance from bottom */
    right: 2rem;          /* Distance from right */
    
    font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; /* Keep Arial for legibility */
    color: #e4dddaff;
    font-weight: 200;
    opacity: 0.8;         /* Slightly brighter */
    text-align: right;    /* Aligns text to the right */
  ">
    <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 0.7rem;">
      © 2025 Zhehao Hu. Source code available at <a href="https://github.com/zzzhehao/zzzhehao.github.io" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: underline;">github.com</a>.
    </p>
  </footer>

</div>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    fetch('./assets/backgrounds.json')
      .then(response => response.json())
      .then(images => {
        const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * images.length);
        const selectedImage = images[randomIndex];
        const container = document.getElementById('bg-container');
        if (container) {
          container.style.backgroundImage = `url('${selectedImage}')`;
        }
      })
      .catch(error => console.error('Error loading background images:', error));
  });
</script>
```
